forest.name: Verdant Forest
forest.subtitle: The Briarway
forest.description: A woodland descent of beasts, traps, tangled paths, and living wards.

ashen_farmstead.name: Ashen Farmstead
ashen_farmstead.subtitle: The Cinder Fields
ashen_farmstead.description: A blighted farm of sealed encounters, scorched crops, possessed fieldhands, and a harvest that refuses to die.

crypt.name: Stone Crypt
crypt.subtitle: The Ossuary Depths
crypt.description: A seven-floor burial complex of restless dead, curses, sealed chambers, and necrotic hazards.

sunken_mine.name: Sunken Mine
sunken_mine.subtitle: The Drowned Veins
sunken_mine.description: Flooded tunnels, unstable passages, ore machinery, and things awakened below the waterline.
sunken_mine.unlock_text: Clear the Ashen Farmstead or Stone Crypt.

ember_foundry.name: Ember Foundry
ember_foundry.subtitle: The Furnace Below
ember_foundry.description: A ruined forge of conveyors, constructs, molten channels, and weapons that still remember war.
ember_foundry.unlock_text: Clear both the Ashen Farmstead and Stone Crypt.

moonlit_grove.name: Moonlit Grove
moonlit_grove.subtitle: The Court Between Leaves
moonlit_grove.description: A secret fae woodland where paths answer promises and fate can be harvested.
moonlit_grove.unlock_text: Find the Forest and Farmstead clues, then research secret paths at the tavern.

abyssal_archive.name: Abyssal Archive
abyssal_archive.subtitle: The Unwritten Stacks
abyssal_archive.description: A forbidden archive where void-touched texts rewrite rooms and readers alike.
abyssal_archive.unlock_text: Find the Crypt and Foundry clues, then research secret paths at the tavern.
